_comment: Source metadata stored once and referenced by stable ID. evidenceCategory is the claim each source can actually carry -- it is not a quality score. Nothing here validates PracticeMap's 0.0-10.0 scale, and no source is cited as if it did.

sources.title: Practicing in rhythms and accents
sources.author: Simon Fischer
sources.supports: Complementary dotted rhythms, varying the pattern's starting point, and attending to pitch, sound, timing and ease.
sources.doesNotSupport: Any claim of a measured improvement rate, or that rhythm practice suits every passage.

sources.title: Optimizing Music Learning: Exploring How Blocked and Interleaved Practice Schedules Affect Advanced Performance
sources.author: Carter and Grahn
sources.supports: Limited support for alternating between passages and revisiting them later.
sources.doesNotSupport: An optimal violin practice schedule. Ten advanced clarinettists, with variation across raters.

sources.title: Putting practice under the microscope: The perceived uses and limitations of slow instrumental music practice
sources.author: Emma Allingham and Clemens Wollner
sources.supports: Framing slow practice around a specific purpose, and acknowledging that slow and fast execution can differ.
sources.doesNotSupport: A universally optimal starting tempo or increment. PracticeMap's tempo numbers are app defaults.
